PROJECT NARRATIVE AND PLANS
(TYPE 1 REZONING)

Re: 1500 North Throop Street

The Applicant seeks a change in zoning from M2-3 Light Industry Zoning District to C3-3
Commercial, Manufacturing and Employment Zoning District, to allow for the operation of a
private event space. The hours of operation for private events will be seven days a week between
10:00 a.m. to 12:00 a.m. Applicant expects to host on average two (2) to four (4) private events
per month, primarily on the weekends.

Lot Area: 3,930 square feet

Floor Area Ratio (Indoor): Floor area = 3,700 square feet
FAR = 0.9487

Density (Lot Area Per Dwelling): N/A - No Dwelling Units

Off-Street Parking: Two Parking Spots

Setbacks Multiple setbacks exist and are all pre-

existing. Most extreme (i.e., closest to each
property line.), per Plat of Survey, are as
follows:
North = 3 feet, 9 inches
South = 0 feet
East = 0 feet

West = 8 feet

Building Height: 12 feet (flat roof)
12 feet, 32 inches (parapet wall)
